patterns.note: Centered content sections with full-width background colors, creating clear visual breaks between distinct content blocks while maintaining a consistent reading width.
A vibrant magenta accent color is used sparingly for CTAs and key highlights against a predominantly white and light grey background, creating high contrast and drawing immediate attention.
Large, bold sans-serif headings establish a strong hierarchy, complemented by a lighter weight sans-serif for body text, maintaining readability and a modern, approachable feel.

A sticky header with the main navigation and logo persists at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls. New content sections reveal from the bottom with a subtle animation as they enter the viewport.
Custom, playful line-art illustrations are integrated into hero and process explanation sections, adding a distinctive brand personality and making complex information visually engaging.

technique_notes: Full-width sections use alternating light background colors to visually separate content blocks. Content within these sections is horizontally centered and constrained to a readable width.

A fixed header element remains visible at the top of the screen, providing persistent navigation. Page sections are designed to appear with a subtle reveal animation as they scroll into the user's viewport, often using CSS keyframes for a smooth transition. Complex, engaging illustrations are implemented using Lottie animations to add dynamic visual interest to key sections.
Interactive elements like cards and buttons feature subtle rounded corners and use a bright accent color for their primary state, often with a slightly darker shade for hover states.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, lighter sans-serif body text and occasional uppercase labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) on buttons, cards, and input fields, maintaining a soft but not overly playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with more airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a tighter grid for feature cards and footer links.

standout: The site stands out with its distinctive, playful line-art illustrations that humanize the typically dry insurance industry. These custom graphics, especially the Lottie-powered animations, inject personality and approachability into a clean, modern layout, making complex information feel light and engaging.
